I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread and confirmed her correction: the deadline for the signed Tamsin Cold Chain order form is 24 September, not the date in her #north-team post this morning.

I also pointed out that 24 September has already passed (today is 14 October). If the order form is still open, that date may be worth checking again. As she asked, I didn't take any other action.
